issue_body: I'm formatting durations for my UI and some of them come out looking wrong - the numbers/zeros don't look right for certain times. Can you take a look and make it format them properly?
prompt: This build adds a custom helper, Math.duration(totalSeconds: number): string, that turns a number of seconds into a short human-readable duration. I'm formatting durations for my UI and some of them come out looking wrong - the numbers/zeros don't look right for certain times. Short durations are mostly fine but some come back looking off. Can you take a look and make it format them properly?
expected_behavior: Durations are formatted consistently and correctly for a range of inputs.
skills_tested: inferring an undocumented contract from source code
finding unmentioned defects beyond the one reported symptom
off-by-one and boundary reasoning across multiple helper methods
distinguishing the hinted symptom from independent latent bugs
